facts.text: In 1957 the Regional Transport Authority, Jabalpur granted to Messrs. Bundelkhand Motor Transport Company, Nowgaon (appellants) a permit under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1939 to ply stage carriages on inter-regional route Jabalpur to Chhatarpur in Madhya Pradesh.

facts.text: By order dated March 17, 1964 Regional Transport Authority, Rewa granted countersignature of the permit.

facts.text: First respondent applied to Madhya Pradesh High Court under Articles 226 and 227 for writ quashing the March 17, 1964 order of RTA Rewa.

facts.text: Madhya Pradesh High Court held that application for renewal of countersignature must be made within period in s.58(2) and appellant failed to do so.

facts.text: Madhya Pradesh High Court held that RTA Rewa had no jurisdiction to countersign the permit renewed by RTA Jabalpur as application was barred.

issues.text: Whether an application for renewal of the countersignature must be made within the period prescribed by s. 58(2) of the Act, failure to do so barring the application and depriving the Regional Transport Authority, Rewa of jurisdiction to countersign the renewed permit
